question: The first passenger train in India ran between ________ and ________ in the year 1853.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Bombay, Thane.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The first passenger train in India ran between **Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane** on 16 April 1853.
 
• The first train began from **Bori Bunder in Bombay at 3:35 pm on April 16, 1853 w,ith a 21-gun salute**.
 
• It was worked by three engines, named **Sahib, Sultan, and Sindh, **and had thirteen carriages.
 
• The first railway line in India was built during the rule of** Lord Dalhousie.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e3841aa7799079d710f1d40b4ab0066758f152ab6b4f1d509a8a877dc96ade5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Indian railways are **the largest public sector undertaking in India**. 
 
• Railways are the main mode of shipment for goods and passengers in India.
 
• A railway is **a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails**.
 
• Indian Railways (IR) is **a statutory body under the ownership of The Ministry of Railways, Government of India that operates India's national railway system**.
